pairs: A Canticle Psalm of David himself.
and may his enemies be scattered,
et fugiant qui oderunt eum a facie ejus.
and may those who hate him flee from before his face.
sicut fluit cera a facie ignis,
Just as wax flows away before the face of fire,
sic pereant peccatores a facie Dei.
so may sinners pass away before the face of God.
and let them exult in the sight of God and be delighted in gladness.
sing a psalm to his name.
iter facite ei qui ascendit super occasum.
Make a path for him, who ascends over the west.
exsultate in conspectu ejus. Turbabuntur a facie ejus,
Exult in his sight; they will be stirred up before his face,
God is in his holy place.
Deus qui inhabitare facit unius moris in domo;
It is God who makes men dwell in a house under one custom.
He leads out those who are strongly bound,
cum egredereris in conspectu populi tui,
when you departed in the sight of your people,
when you passed through the desert,
etenim cæli distillaverunt, a facie Dei Sinai,
for the heavens rained down before the face of the God of Sinai,
before the face of the God of Israel.
You will set aside for your inheritance,
truly, you have made it perfect.
Your animals will dwell in it. O God,
parasti in dulcedine tua pauperi, Deus.
in your sweetness, you have provided for the poor.
The Lord will give the word to evangelizers,
The King of virtue is beloved among the beloved.
And the beauty of the house will divide spoils.
If you take your rest in the midst of the clergy,
you will be like a dove whose wings are covered with fine silver
et posteriora dorsi ejus in pallore auri.
Dum discernit cælestis reges super eam,
When heaven discerns kings to be over her,
they will be whitened with the snows of Zalmon.
The mountain of God is a fat mountain,
So then, why are you distrustful of dense mountains?
mons in quo beneplacitum est Deo habitare in eo;
The mountain on which God is well pleased to dwell,
even there, the Lord will dwell until the end.
The chariot of God is ten thousand fold:
The Lord is with them in Sinai,
You have accepted gifts among men.
etenim non credentes inhabitare Dominum Deum.
For even those who do not believe dwell with the Lord God.
Blessed is the Lord, day after day.
prosperum iter faciet nobis Deus salutarium nostrorum.
The God of our salvation will make our journey prosper for us.
Our God is the God who will bring about our salvation,
and our Lord is the Lord who has brought an end to death.
Verumtamen Deus confringet capita inimicorum suorum,
So then, truly, God will break the heads of his enemies,
verticem capilli perambulantium in delictis suis.
the hairy skull of those who wander around in their offenses.
I will turn them away from Bashan,
I will turn them into the depths of the sea,
ut intingatur pes tuus in sanguine;
so that your feet may be soaked in the blood of your enemies,
lingua canum tuorum ex inimicis, ab ipso.
so that the tongue of your dogs may be soaked with the same.
O God, they have seen your arrival,
regis mei, qui est in sancto.
of my king who is in a holy place.
The leaders went ahead, united with the singers of psalms,
in the midst of girls playing on timbrels.
In ecclesiis benedicite Deo Domino de fontibus Israël.
In the churches, bless the Lord God from the fountains of Israel.
Ibi Benjamin adolescentulus, in mentis excessu;
In that place, Benjamin is a youth in ecstasy of mind.
The leaders of Judah are their governors:
O God. Confirm in this place,
what you have wrought in us.
kings will offer gifts to you.
Rebuke the wild beasts of the reeds,
a congregation of bulls with the cows of the people,
ut excludant eos qui probati sunt argento.
for they seek to exclude those who have been tested like silver.
Scatter the nations that are pleased by wars.
Ambassadors will come out of Egypt.
Ethiopia will offer in advance her hands to God.
He ascends, up to the heaven of the heavens,
ecce dabit voci suæ vocem virtutis.
Behold, he will utter his voice, the voice of virtue.
Give glory to God beyond Israel.
magnificentia ejus et virtus ejus in nubibus.
His magnificence and his virtue is in the clouds.
God is wonderful in his saints.
Deus Israël ipse dabit virtutem et fortitudinem plebi suæ.
The God of Israel himself will give virtue and strength to his people.
